about.text: A cold beet soup of the Polish-Lithuanian tradition, named as part of Lithuanian cuisine. Beets are chilled, kefir, soured milk or buttermilk is poured over, and cucumber, a hard-boiled egg, dill, spring onion and parsley are added; it is eaten with boiled potatoes or bread.

sources.text: Its description, origin and method, and the kefir used in it, from these.
